newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 0.76 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 601.96 from 606.59 on Friday.
Trade volume was 2.06 million dinars against 1.06 million dinars.
Retail stores MONOPRIX was up 1.39 dinar to 47.79 dinars. UBCI bank won one dinar to 51.2 dinars. ($=0.98 dinar)
